item.title: GREEN: Carney government relocates EV mandate to regulatory witness protection
item.description: I’d like to praise Prime Minister Carney for ending the EV mandate — but I can’t because he didn’t. Instead, he simply hid the EV mandate under a new name and buried it in pre-existing air pollution regulations...

item.title: HILL: Smith government continues on resource revenue rollercoaster with $9.4 billion budget deficit
item.description: When governments use one-time volatile resource revenue to finance permanently higher spending, as successive Alberta governments have done, deficits emerge when the good times stop.
